    Careers

    Information system analyst

    Incentives Solutions, a leader in the global SPM (Sales Performance Management) market, is seeking an Information system analyst for the delivery services team.

    Job Description:

    Collecting and understanding the customer’s business needs and requirements, and translating them into a technological solution.
    Improving work processes among a variety of customers, while implementing and customizing a solution using different tools.
    The role requires a broad business understanding and a technological approach.
    The majority of work will take place on customer site, within leading organizations in the Israel (central area) market.

    Job Requirements:

    B.A or B.Sc.: Business Administration/Economics/Industrial Engineering.
    Advanced analytical skills, data analysis from detail design documents and Excel- A MUST.
    Highly advanced interpersonal and service-oriented skills-A MUST.
    Experience utilizing SQL database/Analysis- Advantage.
    Previous experience in data analysis and/or BI systems- Advantage.

    Submit nominations
    General Application

    We’re always on the lookout for new talent, and if you didn’t find an opening that fits your skills,
    we would be happy to receive your resume and we will do our best to match a spot in the future

    Please share your CV via email to jobs@incentives-solutions.com or through the submission form.
